notes: Selection: of the templates whose `when` matches, the most specific win, then ties are drawn by weight with createRng(seed, gameId, 'text', index). Specificity is a weighted key count: walkoff and milestone 4, env 3, goAhead/tying/basesLoaded 2, every other key 1. Every `on` kind has no-condition fallbacks.
